notes: No state rows. pepsico.com hosts a 2024 U.S. economic impact page (pepsico.com/about/economic-impact) and a PDF ('PepsiCo_2024_US-impact.pdf') that web search describes as an Oxford Economics study with state-level results; it could not be read (pepsico.com's bot protection returned 403 to curl, WebFetch and a headless browser on 2026-11-23, and to curl and WebFetch again on 2026-11-24), so neither its contents nor whether a newer edition exists could be checked, and nothing from it is recorded. The 2025 10-K gives ~306,000 employees with ~125,000 in the U.S. as of Dec 27, 2025 (US country row) and no other country or state split. Item 2 now lists significant properties under the new segments (PFNA, PBNA, IB Franchise, EMEA, LatAm Foods) in 15 rows without counts by state or country; 10 are used as sites (Russia plants, Lehavim (Israel), Vallejo, Colonia and Singapore omitted, as before). The Shanghai and Riyadh plants used last year are no longer in the table and were removed.
